Opens in a new tab ## Team of Motivated “Learn-it-alls” # Meet the Team We are a mix of US Special Operations, US National Security, and cybersecurity industry veterans. Our mission is to “turn the map around” – using the attacker’s perspective to help enterprises prioritize defensive efforts. Founded in 2019, Horizon3 is headquartered in San Francisco, CA, and 100% made in the USA. Vision Comfort Eye Strain Streamline Icon: https://streamlinehq.com ##### Our Vision The future of cyber warfare will run at machine speed – algorithm vs. algorithm – with humans by exception. [Read: Future of Cybersecurity →](https://horizon3.ai/horizon3-security-vision/) Multiple Actions Add Streamline Icon: https://streamlinehq.com ##### Join the Team If you want to be part of a kick-ass organization hell bent on disrupting an industry and keeping attackers at bay, let’s talk… [Horizon3 Careers →](https://horizon3.ai/join-our-team/) ## Horizon3 Leadership ![](https://horizon3.ai/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/600x600_Snehal_2309-300x300.jpg) - [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/snehalantani/) ### Snehal Antani Co-Founder, CEO Snehal Antani is the Co-Founder and CEO of Horizon3, where he leads the company’s mission to empower organizations to proactively defend their infrastructure through autonomous security solutions. With a unique blend of entrepreneurial, public sector, and enterprise leadership experience, Snehal previously served as CTO of JSOC, CTO at Splunk, and CIO at GE Capital. An industry-recognized technologist and innovation advocate, Snehal holds 18 U.S. patents in data processing, cloud computing, and virtualization. He is a sought-after keynote speaker and a prolific writer on topics including leadership, digital transformation, cybersecurity, and cloud architecture. ### Matthew Hartley Chief Revenue Officer Matt Hartley is the Chief Revenue Officer at Horizon3, where he oversees global go-to-market strategy, revenue growth, and customer success. With more than two decades of experience building and scaling high-performing teams, Matt has a proven track record of delivering revenue predictability and operational excellence across sales, marketing, and customer engagement. Prior to Horizon3, Matt held CRO roles at HYPR (a leader in phishing-resistant authentication) and iboss (a pioneer in SASE/SSE). He also served as Vice President of Americas Sales at Forescout, where he built and expanded the U.S. Federal business. Earlier in his career, Matt held senior sales leadership roles at Optio Labs, MobileIron, and other innovative technology companies. ![](https://horizon3.ai/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/matt-h-bw-300x300.jpg) - [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mrhartley101/) ![Holly Grey, CFO](https://horizon3.ai/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/Holly-Grey-bw-headshot-300x300.jpg) - [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/holly-grey-9946a71/) ### Holly Grey - In Memoriam Chief Financial Officer In loving memory of Holly, who passed away in June 2026. We deeply mourn her passing and extend our heartfelt condolences to her family and loved ones. Holly's visionary leadership, warmth, and profound contributions left an indelible mark on Horizon3 and everyone she ever worked with. She will be deeply missed by all of us. Holly Grey was the Chief Financial Officer at Horizon3, where she oversaw the financial systems and operations to support scale, growth and collaboration. With over 30 years of experience, Holly helped companies navigate mergers and acquisitions, IPO’s and build-out of teams and operations that have supported triple digit growth. Holly held senior roles at Exabeam, Forescout Technologies, Accuray and Aspect Software. Driven by a passion for excellence, Holly valued continuous improvement, innovation, and proactive problem-solving. She was deeply committed to helping organizations achieve their strategic goals while fostering a culture of growth and integrity. Holly held a B.A. from Boston College. ### Andres Botero Chief Marketing Officer Andres Botero is a seasoned enterprise software marketing and strategy executive with more than two decades of experience scaling high-growth technology companies. He has led global go-to-market strategy, brand, and demand generation for category-defining cloud and cybersecurity organizations, with a strong track record of driving ARR growth, market expansion, and successful exits. Prior to his most recent leadership roles, Andres served as Chief Marketing Officer at Rubrik and Chief Strategy & Marketing Officer at BlackLine, and held senior marketing leadership positions at CallidusCloud (acquired by SAP), Aria Systems, SAP, and Siebel Systems. He holds an MBA from Stanford Graduate School of Business and a BS from Universidad de Los Andes. ![Andres Botero, Chief Marketing Officer at Horizon3.ai](https://horizon3.ai/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/IMG_5110-300x300.jpg) - [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/andresmbotero) ### Jill Passalacqua Chief Legal Officer Jill Passalacqua is the Chief Legal Officer at Horizon3, where she scales legal strategy to support innovation and enterprise growth. With decades of experience guiding companies from startup to IPO and acquisition, she’s held executive legal roles at JumpCloud, Harness, Avi Networks (acquired by VMware), FireEye, and NetApp. Jill is known for aligning legal operations with business goals, enabling global expansion, and leading high-performing teams. She also serves on the board of the Palisades Tahoe Community Foundation. Jill holds a B.A. from UCLA and a J.D. from Santa Clara University. ![](https://horizon3.ai/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/Jill-Passalacqua-BW-300x300.jpg) - [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jill-passalacqua-2251663/) ![Torie Runzel](https://horizon3.ai/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/Torie-R-BW-400x400-1-300x300.jpg) - [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/torierunzel/) ### Torie Runzel Chief People Officer Torie Runzel is the Vice President of People at Horizon3, where she leads talent strategy and corporate operations to ensure the organization scales with speed, alignment, and impact. She brings 15 years of experience growing technology companies across cybersecurity, fintech, logistics, and proptech, with a focus on performance-driven, values-aligned cultures. Before joining Horizon3 in 2023, Torie served as VP of People at Divvy Homes and previously held leadership roles at Bolt Financial and CoLane Logistics. She has successfully built and led people operations, organizational development, compensation, DEI initiatives, and strategic planning functions. A former founder and startup operator, Torie is known for designing scalable systems, driving business outcomes, and enabling cross-functional leadership at high-growth startups. ### Ellen Sundra [Chief Customer Officer](https://www.linkedin.com/in/erickdean/) Ellen Sundra is the Chief Customer Officer at Horizon3, leading Sales Engineering, Customer Success, Support, Enablement and Field CTOs. With over two decades of cybersecurity leadership experience, including her role as Chief Customer Officer at Forescout Technologies, Ellen drives customer-centric innovation and strategic growth. Ellen holds a BA in Computer Science from Rollins College and has completed Executive Leadership training at Harvard Business School. Recognized as one of the Top 25 Women in Cyber (Cyber Defense Magazine) and Cybersecurity Woman of the Year (Cyber Excellence Awards), Ellen is committed to helping organizations translate complex cybersecurity challenges into measurable business outcomes. ![A professional photo of Ellen Sundra, the Chief Customer Officer of Horizon3](https://horizon3.ai/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/ellen-sundra-chief-customer-300x300.png) - [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/esundra/) ![A photo of Erick Dean, Vice President of Products for Horizon3](https://horizon3.ai/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/eric-d-bw-300x300.jpg) - [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/erickdean/) ### Erick Dean Vice President of Product Erick Dean is the Vice President of Product Management at Horizon3, where he directs product strategy, execution, and market alignment for the company’s autonomous security platform. A seasoned product leader with over 20 years of experience, Erick brings deep expertise in enterprise software, cybersecurity, and AI-powered automation. Before joining Horizon3 in 2024, Erick led AIOps product initiatives at PagerDuty. He also held product leadership roles at Samsara, Splunk, and C3.ai, delivering SaaS and machine learning solutions that drove operational efficiency and revenue growth. Erick is the author of six patents in machine learning and analytics, and his background includes engineering and consulting roles at McKinsey, ON Semiconductor, and National Instruments. He excels at bridging customer needs, product innovation, and go-to-market execution. ![Keith Poyser](https://horizon3.ai/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Keith-Poyser-bw-300x300.jpg) - [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/keith-poyser-883979/) ##### Keith Poyser General Manager, EMEA ##### ![Drew Mullen](https://horizon3.ai/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/DrewMullen-bw-300x300.jpg) -
